card.name: Punctuation before "do not" instructions
card.fires_on: The semicolon, period or comma right after a short handling command such as "Swallow whole" or "Swirl gently", where a "do not" warning comes next.

modes.label: Swallow whole
modes.description: Punctuation after an instruction to swallow a capsule or tablet whole, before "do not chew/crush".

modes.label: Gentle vial handling
modes.description: Punctuation after a command to swirl a vial gently, before "do not shake/invert".
modes.example: Gently swirl the EPKINLY vial<<.>> DO NOT invert, vortex, or vigorously

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "don't" or "do not" as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a short handling instruction where a "do not" warning usually follows.
